items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: He was the bass player, anyway. ... And he would get juiced. But a good foundation bass player and could play solos. He was a good bass player. And a wonderful bass player.

ctx.x: Greshon Brother Moncyr was the bass --

items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Escudero was the bass player... Escudero left... Billy Taylor to come in Escudero's place.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. And the saxophones was Edward Inge and Jimmy Dudley and Prince Robinson. Jim Larson was the drummer and Dave Wilburn was the guitar player and Escudero was the bass player.
